sections.qualitative: 285 tenant calls × .8 unique fraction × .2 incremental housing/stress responders × .04 utility × .5 years × .4 funding additionality. All conversions judged. sections.cost: Whole-recipient FY ended June30,2023 PartIX expense795803. Original ScheduleD reconciles audited and return expense at795803; donated-service and direct event addbacks are not reported in the inspected fields. Blank fields do not prove no unrecognized volunteer or partner resources. This is an accounting-cost floor scenario, not measured full economic cost. All recipient support costs retained. Activity is calendar2023, whereas cost is July2022–June2023: the periods overlap only six months. This is a rough annual historical pairing, not exact contemporaneous matching. An augmented-cost sensitivity increases the numerator50% without treating that arbitrary allowance as complete.
sections.funding: FY2023 original return reports revenue802710 and net assets695883. These dated accounting balances do not establish current liquidity or a donation-sensitive gap. More recent FY2025 return is listed but not used in this historical scenario. No priced marginal capacity verified. Official About page links the donation form; no transaction attempted.

model.geographicAttribution: Modeled service cohort is specifically Evanston, Cook County, fully within pinned Chicago MSA; g=1 conditional on this cohort, not all organization outputs. Broader Chicago work confirmed by original mission page but unquantified here.
model.nativeOutcomes: Original City of Evanston 2023 report p1 records 305 calls, 285 tenant-initiated (20 landlord-initiated), 71 city requests and 29 texts. Only 285 tenant calls used; k=.8 assumed unique-person fraction. Exclude texts, requests, units and all Chicago calls rather than double count unverified overlap. This is a narrow documented pathway, not complete organizational impact.
model.counterfactual: a represents incremental response beyond alternative services; b discounts replacement funding and capacity limits. Both are judgments, not observed causal estimates.
model.attribution: 285 tenant calls × .8 unique fraction × .2 incremental housing/stress responders × .04 utility × .5 years × .4 funding additionality. All conversions judged. Other recipient pathways provisionally zero; this omission does not establish a lower bound. No family or policy multiplication.
model.uncertainty: All conversion parameters are illustrative judgments without probabilities, calibration or recipient causal QALY evidence. Scenarios are not confidence intervals or exhaustive bounds. Benefits of rights and autonomy beyond health are unpriced. Costs are not comparable full economic resource costs.
sensitivity: Zero additionality yields zero benefit and no finite price.
Poor and favorable vary multiple unsupported assumptions; these are illustrative scenarios, not probabilistic bounds.
Cost changes scale price proportionally; benefit factors scale price inversely.
Other organizational pathways are not quantified; omitted benefits are not demonstrated zero.
A50%cost allowance tests missing resources; not calibrated or complete. Lower local share and net-harm stresses show additional downside; no probability weights.
